payload.findings_fixed: Second collection, all fixed in this pass (first pass run-c78143bd greened the suite; walking the machine then exposed two engine defects and absorbed two owner rulings): (1) recovery-edge misclassification - advance() treated recovery as a failure path, so a successful fix had no legal edge and the machine recorded a bogus escape; fixed in advance() (recovery fires on filled) and in completeState (OR-path activation for alternative/recovery/fallback/error), guarded by two new tests; the bogus escape removed from the instance record. (2) The loop's own engine-filled runs blocked inline - the very 5s defect the register outlaws; next() now starts commands as background runs with a 900ms grace: fast commands keep the synchronous shape, longer ones return a running packet with the run ref, completed on the next call; guarded by the slow-verify integration test. (3) req-test-lane amended per owner ruling (individual tests). (4) Toll grace-warning ruling captured as note c744cf1c, deliberately NOT built in this pass per owner. Battery after the pass: typecheck clean, 91/91 green (run-74514a56).
